note: 8-bit rendering for display only. It is a derivative of the measured image, not the measured data: every reported intensity in `result` is in the source's own DN at its own bit depth, and was computed from the unrescaled pixels. One output level spans `mapping.source_dn_per_output_level` source DN, so a pixel reading 255 here is not evidence of saturation: saturation is a QC judgement made on the measured pixels and reported in `result`.
